facts.fact: Starlink is on sale in Nigeria, its largest market in Sub-Saharan Africa per Dataxis, with equipment at USD 435; it reportedly refused new subscribers in Lagos and other major cities at end 2025.
Amazon obtained a licence to operate Amazon LEO (formerly Project Kuiper) in Nigeria in January 2026, per Dataxis.

systems.platform: LEO satellite broadband, licensed, not yet on sale
